text:
maya: Heads-up — PR #21468 is ready from my side but the CI matrix is queued. Holding merge to avoid the deploy blackout tonight. Anyone able to nudge the runners or suggest a safe merge window?

sam: Which jobs are queued? can you paste the failing/waiting job names so I can check the runners? @alex FYI.

maya: It’s not failing — all `integration/matrix` shards are `queued` (linux, mac, windows). Link: https://ci.redwood/21468

ci-bot: Status: all matrix shards queued. Backpressure: concurrent_runner_limit (us-west-2). Estimated wait ~20m, rerun allowed when quota frees.

alex: Reminder — we have a deploy blackout 22:00-23:00 UTC tonight. If we land during that, ops will need to coordinate. Prefer landing before 20:00 or after 00:30.

maya: Not critical but would like to avoid another rebase tomorrow. If infra can bump priority for this PR, that would help. @sam can you try? :pray:

sam: I can request a priority bump but infra needs to approve. I’ll file the ticket now.

infra-bot: Ticket INF-4227 created for priority bump request. Manual approval required from infra oncall.

julie: I can approve a short exception if QA + infra give thumbs-up. @sam can you confirm a rerun won't make flakes worse? also please add `merge-delay` label if we end up waiting. :eyes:

sam: I reviewed the recent flakes — they look unrelated. Rerun should be safe. If infra approves priority, I’ll rerun the matrix and watch.

alex: Suggestion: add a short smoke script to the PR description so we can do a quick post-merge canary if we land close to blackout. Example:

```
# smoke test steps
1. deploy to staging-canary
2. POST /health -> expect 200
3. run small-e2e.sh --timeout 60s
```

maya: Added the smoke steps to the PR description. I’ll wait 30m for infra to respond to INF-4227 and then ping again. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

sam: Noted — I’ll follow up in INF-4227 and ping infra oncall.

infra-bot: INF-4227 updated: awaiting oncall approval. Priority: medium -> requested high.

maya: Leaving this thread for async updates — I’ll post again if we get runner quota or decide to postpone until after blackout.
